column3: AeroGuard. Your flight is late. You're already paid.
Our contract pays only on flight data signed by the AeroDataBox Airnode on API3 AirnodeHub. No claim forms.
Eleven real policies on real flights from Munich. The first four were settled by our keeper, on the signed arrival.
The keeper pays five cents over x402 for a signed answer, checks it, and settles. No human in the loop.

Four forgeries against the live contract. An edited value: not signed by the Airnode. A real answer for another flight: wrong request. An attacker's key: rejected. An old answer: stale. The genuine answer is accepted.
The Security Inspector re-runs every contract check, right in your browser.
An AI agent asks our verdict service. It answers four oh two: pay two test ADA over x402 on Cardano.
The agent pays on preprod, and gets the verdict plus the same Airnode signature. It pays only for a result a contract can check.
Our Aiken escrow verifies that same signature on Cardano, and pays by the rule.
No signature, no money moves. AeroGuard.
